description.en: Sets a temporary, map-scoped byte-sized value (see CMND_SET_TEMP_MAP_BIT_FLAG for the bit version), identified by a numeric index. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.
Index of the temporary map-scoped byte value to set.

example.code:
// Store a map-local counter value
CMND_SET_TEMP_MAP_BYTE_FLAG(0, 2);
